prompt: Make moving between pages on the site feel instant: when a link in the header navigation (Stories, Routes, Gear, About) is clicked, fetch that page and swap in its main content without a full reload, updating the address bar. Underline and bold the header link of the page being shown. Back and Forward must still work. Plain JavaScript in one assets/nav.js file included on every page, no libraries. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
